caesar.description: Shifts every letter a fixed number of places along the alphabet.

rot13.description: A Caesar shift by 13, so applying it twice returns the original text.

atbash.description: Mirrors the alphabet: A becomes Z, B becomes Y and so on.

base64.description: Encodes bytes using 64 printable characters, often ending with = padding.

base32.description: Encodes bytes using the letters A–Z and digits 2–7.

hex.description: Writes every byte of the text as two hexadecimal digits.

binary.description: Writes every byte of the text as eight zeros and ones.

morse.description: Dots and dashes; letters are separated by spaces and words by a vertical bar.

a1z26.description: Replaces every letter with its position in the alphabet, A = 1 to Z = 26.

vigenere.description: Shifts each letter by the matching letter of a repeating keyword.

xor.description: Combines every byte with a repeating key using XOR; the result is shown as hex.
